network.description: 2 x 2 signalised grid, two-lane streets, 200 m blocks, 8 entry/exit stubs

fixed_time.title: Fixed-time
fixed_time.detail: Pre-timed plan, 30 s green per stage; ignores traffic.

queue_heuristic.title: FlowState adaptive
queue_heuristic.detail: Queue-responsive: switches when the waiting stage has clearly more demand, gaps out empty greens, holds when the exit is full and gives way to emergency vehicles.

rl_ppo.title: RL policy (PPO)
rl_ppo.detail: Trained in SUMO. Failed the publication gate, so it is shown for reference only.

scenarios.title: Balanced
scenarios.description: Equal demand on all eight entries.

scenarios.title: North-south heavy
scenarios.description: North and south entries carry about three times the east-west demand.

scenarios.title: East-west heavy
scenarios.description: East and west entries carry about three times the north-south demand.

scenarios.title: Alternating pulses
scenarios.description: The dominant direction flips every 240 s.

scenarios.title: Rush-hour ramp
scenarios.description: All entries ramp up to 1.5x, hold and ease. Never used for tuning or training.
